name: Space Battleship Yamato: Voyagers of Tomorrow
summary: Space Battleship Yamato: Voyagers of Tomorrow is an online strategy simulation game based on the Space Battleship Yamato anime series, created from Yoshinobu Nishizaki's original work. Players command a fleet of super-dreadnoughts, unlocking and upgrading facilities, collecting mechas and recruiting crew members from the series to build up their forces, and fire the Wave Motion Gun in large-scale space battles. The game runs in a web browser with no download required.
